query: I have a 67-year-old female patient. Among female Medicare patients aged 62–72 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of syncope (ICD-9 780.2 or ICD-10 R55), what is the total number of index admissions in this cohort?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS total_index_admissions
FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
  ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
WHERE p.gender = 'F'
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - p.anchor_year + p.anchor_age BETWEEN 62 AND 72
  AND a.admission_location = 'EMERGENCY ROOM'
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND (
    (d.icd_version = 9 AND d.icd_code = '7802') 
    OR 
    (d.icd_version = 10 AND d.icd_code = 'R55')
  );
